case: bytea[] binary, empty and NULL elements through JSON, CSV, XLSX and replayed SQL file writers
contract: The native array contains bytes 00ff275c (including non-UTF-8 and quote/backslash bytes), empty bytea and SQL NULL; server unnest/encode verifies each position and exact bytes.

PostgreSQL pg_typeof, canonical array text, array_to_json and array_send provide independent native type, value, JSON and wire oracles; driver metadata remains BYTEA[] while PostgreSQL reports bytea[].
Binding the driver's bytea[] text reproduces native JSON and array_send values.
JSON and CSV preserve the driver's exact array text; XLSX stores it as a non-formula shared-string cell.
Replayed SQL restores the exact PostgreSQL type, canonical text, JSON and wire bytes.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_bytea_array_file_exports_preserve_binary_elements -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families, array/session combinations, spreadsheet application re-import for this family and the broader B3 consumer matrix remain open.
